adjudication.rationale: In handleNewBooking.ts the code can build a multi-calendar event for COLLECTIVE team events by pushing additional members’ destination calendars into `evt.destinationCalendar` (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`). But when persisting the booking it only connects the first calendar: `connect: { id: evt.destinationCalendar[0].id }` (so only one DestinationCalendar relation is stored on the booking). Later flows in this diff reconstruct CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar from `booking.destinationCalendar`/`user.destinationCalendar` as a single-element array (e.g. confirm.handler.ts, requestReschedule.handler.ts, payment webhooks), so they cannot recreate the full set of destination calendars and will operate on only that one (the persisted/main host) when creating events from those rebuilt `evt` objects.
